parameter_provenance.label: Adaptive high-yield / 45-55 C (user settings)

notes.explanation: The preferred short range is retained. New candidates may be extended and rechecked to recover useful sites; an existing ordered sequence is never silently lengthened.

notes.origin: PROJECT SEARCH CEILING, NOT PAPER LIMIT
notes.explanation: This is the maximum genomic arm, not the full primary. The program checks lengths one base at a time and favors short feasible alternatives; it does not turn every probe into a 90-mer.
This replaces 42-50 C for the active default. Salt, concentration, formamide correction, aqueous folding temperature and off-target thresholds are unchanged.

Compare a short-arm baseline, longer infill and two joint greedy searches. Keep the highest-site-count feasible result. Count targets are benchmarks unless capped-count mode is selected; no global-optimum or brighter-signal guarantee.

notes.setting: Published comparison window (not the current user default)
notes.explanation: The separately selectable Ellenberg-informed preset reports 42-50 C accounting for 2xSSC and 50% formamide. Strict endpoints are inherited OligoMiner-style implementation details.

notes.value: DNA_NN3; 390 mM sodium; 2 nM probe / trace target; 50% FA x 0.65 C/%
notes.explanation: The paper does not give its complete thermodynamic command line. 2 nM per primary is a reported experimental concentration; using it with trace target is our modeling choice, not proof of the paper's calculation. Default 25/25 nM software comparison remains selectable.

The paper does not report primary-arm GC cutoffs. The 76% cap is documented in our expanded G5 audit; a precise cap was not established for the earliest pilot. The paper's 40-50% GC rule applies to short imagers, NOT primary binding arms. Tm still constrains low-GC candidates.
The paper used at least 2 nt spacing. We retain your requested 5 bp and include contiguous spacer/handle matching. Tracing regions themselves remain adjacent.

notes.value: At most 5 consecutive identical bases; exclude 8 dinucleotide units
notes.explanation: These are project sequence-quality filters. The paper's separate short-imager filters are not substituted for primary-arm rules.

notes.setting: Region width and target oligo count
notes.explanation: The paper reports up to 100 primaries in 10 kb per position. A separate button applies that planning example. It is not forced on short construct inputs or on a user-chosen tracing resolution.

notes.value: One fixed DNA strand; transcript-sequence screening ON; whole-gene exclusion OFF by default
notes.explanation: All tracing probes keep the same chosen DNA-bound strand. Gene spans do not automatically exclude candidates in the default mode. Long/high-identity complementary RNA matches still affect selection; isolated 18-nt hits are review evidence. Strict span exclusion remains optional. No RNA-free or allele-identity guarantee.

The paper reports a 42 C LDA model at 0.8 and 5 or 10 off-target 18-mers. This program does not implement that complete LDA/k-mer pipeline. Its BLAST, off-target Tm, aqueous folding and pair gates are labeled separately.

sources.user_update: User request, 13-14 October 2026: fixed trace-wide strand, transcript-only RNA policy available/default in 1.5; permit longer arms when useful to meet remaining criteria and increase compatible binding-site count; change selection Tm window to 45-55 C.
sources.paper: Beckwith et al., Nature Communications 16:6673 (2025), Primary FISH probe design and Non-denaturing FISH; DOI 10.1038/s41467-025-61689-y.
sources.initial_record: RASERFISH_primary_probe_design_parameters_and_logic.pdf, sections 3-6: initial 68-oligo pilot used mostly 36-42 nt candidates; four long R2 additions were exceptions.
sources.project_audit: REVIEW_README.txt, G5 arm-selection audit: 36-90 nt, GC <=76%, no explicit lower GC cutoff, no homopolymer >=6; inherited expanded-project settings, not claimed original paper settings.

explicit_nonimplementation: Complete Ellenberg command line not recovered
parameter_provenance.statement: Reported paper values are distinguished from project/user choices. Selecting a preset is not experimental validation.

transcription_summary.note: Annotations remain visible; no whole-span masking or inferred unspliced RNA was generated. Supplied RNA sequences and requested RNA database searches are independent.

strand_audit.scope: One fixed reference-relative target strand across this run. Mapped fragments on the same chromosome are checked for a consistent genomic strand. Unmapped construct-fragment connectivity is not inferred. Other independent runs must use the same global strand and be checked together. This does not identify maternal/paternal homologs or guarantee one chromatid experimentally.

warnings: Whole-gene RNA-span exclusion is OFF. Annotated-transcript sequence screening remains requested; short partial RNA hits are review evidence, not automatic rejections. This is not an RNA-free guarantee and does not assume RNase treatment was performed.
Adaptive lengths: prefer 36-42 nt; consider extensions through 90 nt under unchanged QC. Finite shortlists and greedy searches do not guarantee a global maximum.
Maximum compatible-site mode: the per-region target count is a comparison benchmark, not a stopping cap. Region widths remain fixed.

All selected primaries must bind the locked + reference-relative DNA strand across ALL tracing regions. RNA criteria operate within the locked strand; there is never strand switching. Other runs must use the same trace-wide strand. This is not a guarantee of chromatid/homolog identity.
Complete construct/vector NOT PROVIDED; public human references do not cover a custom integration.
Genome/RNA BLAST and full folding NOT RUN. This preview must not be treated as a genome-screened order.

algorithm: QC-gated adaptive candidate bands; compare preferred-only baseline, longer infill, site-packing and spatial-balance greedy solutions. Maximize compatible exact sites among tried solutions, not a certified global optimum.
scope: DNA duplex Tm is model-based. Folding is aqueous without formamide/pool equilibrium. Counts are not experimental brightness. Full mode searches arms and complete primaries against the supplied genome/RNA databases; local preview does not. Gene-RNA avoidance is annotation- and declaration-scoped.  Only explicit intended intervals are exempt. No experimental validation.
